content.value: In a sack of mixed grain seeds, the probability that a seed is ryegrass is 0.35. Find the 15 probability that in a random sample of 450 seeds from this sack, i) less than 120 are ryegrass seeds. ii) more than 170 are ryegrass seeds. iii) between 120 and 150 are ryegrass seeds. iv) 160 are ryegrass seeds.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2022
